name: file-tree
description: A file tree of the working directory in a pane beside the transcript, with folders you open and close and the files Claude just changed marked

background.title: Pane background
background.description: Hex color painted behind the tree. The default is half of Windows Terminal's Dark+ background (#1E1E1E). Leave empty to keep the terminal's own background.

coverFrame.title: Draw over the pane's frame
coverFrame.description: Draws the orange border on top of Claude Code's square pane frame instead of just inside it. Turn off if the border goes missing or covers something.
